description: The PMC self-play arena's level data for the generated Depot map /Game/Maps/Generated/L_Gen_Depot_1 (user request 2026-11-03, docs/systems/pmc-squad-ai.md 'Arena'): a copy of L_PmcArena.json - no monster pressure, no cheats (real deaths), fights start on contact (combat_start ambush) as skirmishes, no cold, no intro - plus the Depot's floor heights (minimap floors_cm 300 / 600 / 900) and drop links on, so the squads fight across covers, ladders, roofs and the cut. ONE small wave only because the level file must hold a valid wave (never played). Run: -LevelJson=L_PmcArenaDepot.json with CodexTactics.PmcArena (Spawns=Random is the default off the combat lab).

pmc_arena._comment: CodexTactics.PmcArena's own data (task #53, docs/systems/pmc-squad-ai.md 5): the round objective - the attackers win by holding it (an attacker within objective_radius_m, no live defender within it) for objective_hold_s; the point lies objective_offset_frac (x 0.75-1.25 seeded) of the way from the defender's spawn to the attacker's; a scenario site (chokepoint / street / roofs) puts the defenders defender_offset_m behind it; the chokepoint search wants a passage passage_min_m..passage_max_m wide between walls >= wall_min_height_m.

play_area._comment: fix/arena-no-outer-strip (the game designer 2026-11-10): no arena spawn, squad slot or objective outside this area - the outer strip between the perimeter walls and the map edge is hidden from the camera and teaches the trainer little (AI/PmcArenaPlayArea.h). World cm, XY only. include_box_cm = the generator layout's bounds (Content/Data/LevelGen/accepted/gen_ref_01_02_depot_1.json; the map builder lays 10 m more ground round them: the outer strip); exclude_boxes_cm = the sliver between the long west fence F_south (x -6050, y -3892..8319) and the layout edge.
